title: RoboBuilder: Agentic Robot Co-Design with Real-world Video Feedback in the Loop
abstract: arXiv:2611.23855v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can AI agents design robots that work in the real world? We introduce RoboBuilder, a benchmark in which coding agents co-design a robot's hardware and program from standard parts, motors and a custom 3D-printed part, and every design that passes in simulation is built and tested on a physical course. Simulation alone is not enough: under public part data, none of 15 initial passing designs crossed the real course, so an agent learns the simulator from measurements it requests and videos of real runs. Across four frontier coding agents, ten obstacles at three difficulty levels, 16,427 simulations of 12,774 distinct robots and 135 physical robots built in an estimated 240 hours, agents solve nearly all easy obstacles and invent mechanisms our search baselines do not reach, but falter at harder levels, when one robot must cross every obstacle, and in the real world, where 66% of simulated passes hold across all levels. Closing the loop help

translated_title: RoboBuilder：基于真实世界视频反馈闭环的智能体机器人协同设计
translated_abstract: AI智能体能否设计出在真实世界中正常工作的机器人？我们提出了RoboBuilder，这是一个基准测试平台：编码智能体使用标准零件、电机和定制3D打印部件协同设计机器人的硬件与程序，且每一个通过仿真测试的设计都会被实际制造并在真实物理场地上进行测试。仅靠仿真是不够的：在使用公开零件数据的情况下，最初15个通过仿真的设计中没有一个能通过真实场地的测试，因此智能体需要通过其主动请求的测量数据和真实运行的记录视频来学习校准仿真器。在四个前沿编码智能体、三个难度级别的十个障碍物、12,774个不同机器人的16,427次仿真、以及估计耗时240小时制造的135台实体机器人的大规模实验中，智能体几乎能解决所有简单障碍，并发明出我们的搜索基线无法企及的机构；但在更高难度级别、要求单个机器人跨越所有障碍时，以及在真实世界中表现不佳——仿真通过的设计在所有难度级别上仅有66%能在真实世界中通过测试。闭环反馈有助于……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出RoboBuilder基准，让编码智能体通过“仿真—真实世界视频反馈”闭环协同设计机器人软硬件，实验发现仅靠仿真远远不够（仅66%的仿真通过设计能通过真实测试），但智能体仍能发明出超越搜索基线的机器人机构。
en_tdlr: RoboBuilder introduces a benchmark where coding agents co-design robot hardware and programs with real-world video feedback in the loop, demonstrating that simulation alone is insufficient—only 66% of simulated passes hold in the real world—while agents still invent mechanisms beyond search baselines.
